note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording (and the OT renderings made in its register). The book quotes whole NIV verses and repeats them in its closing Scripture index; each verse now reads identically in the chapter and in the index.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…' where the English elides (Matthew 6:19-20, 2 Corinthians 12:10, Matthew 28:20). Where OWB's wording changed a word the author's next sentence picks up, that sentence follows OWB: 'the ends of the earth' is «እስከ ምድር ዳርቻ», Romans 10:15's feet are «የተዋቡ», 2 Corinthians 9:6 sows «በብዛት», Philippians 1:21's gain is «ትርፍ», James 1:27 is «ንጹሕ ሃይማኖት», and Acts 20:24 counts one's life «ምንም ዋጋ».
